subject: cargo feature unification: whether one workspace member's midly/strict reaches another member
lead: noted by the si-jam-sessions coordinator session, whose workspace builds a strict ingest crate beside crates that would measure non-strict behaviour; measured here
tool: cargo 1.98.1 (797e8a9bc 2026-08-05), resolver 3, --offline, midly 0.5.3 from the local registry

workspace.strict-member/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "strict-member"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
midly = { version = "=0.5.3", default-features = false, features = ["alloc", "strict"] }
workspace.plain-member/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "plain-member"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
midly = { version = "=0.5.3", default-features = false, features = ["alloc"] }

runs.output:
midly v0.5.3
└── midly feature "alloc"
    └── plain-member v0.1.0 (<ws>\plain-member)
        └── plain-member feature "default" (command-line)

midly v0.5.3
├── midly feature "alloc"
│   ├── plain-member v0.1.0 (<ws>\plain-member)
│   │   └── plain-member feature "default" (command-line)
│   └── strict-member v0.1.0 (<ws>\strict-member)
│       └── strict-member feature "default" (command-line)
└── midly feature "strict"
    └── strict-member v0.1.0 (<ws>\strict-member) (*)

runs.command: cargo +1.98.1 tree -e features -i midly --offline   (no package flag, at the virtual workspace root)
runs.output:
midly v0.5.3
├── midly feature "alloc"
│   ├── plain-member v0.1.0 (<ws>\plain-member)
│   │   └── plain-member feature "default" (command-line)
│   └── strict-member v0.1.0 (<ws>\strict-member)
│       └── strict-member feature "default" (command-line)
└── midly feature "strict"
    └── strict-member v0.1.0 (<ws>\strict-member) (*)

source.title: The Cargo Book: Features, Feature unification

conclusion: Cargo resolves features once per command, over the packages that command selects. With -p plain-member, midly is built with alloc only. With --workspace, or with no package flag at a virtual workspace root, midly is built once with alloc + strict for every member. A non-strict measurement in a workspace that has a strict member must run with -p, or in its own workspace.
